name: Time Sword
description: A warm brass blade with a seam of cyan temporal light set one pixel in from the cutting edge and broken by bright graduation marks, like a measuring instrument that happens to have a point. The guard is an hourglass stood on its end — wide, pinched at the waist where the sand shows through, wide again — the only guard in the collection with a waist. Dark leather grip and a small clock-face pommel with a cyan centre.
